name: Learner Drift Guard
description: Post-experiment quality guard for the autonomous scene learner. Validates experiments against golden baselines, detects confidence drift (2-sigma warning, 3-sigma critical), and blocks paid model usage.

data.label: Experiment Result
data.description: Receives experiment result JSON after each learner experiment completes

data.label: Quality Check
data.code:
from services.learner.quality_guard import check_experiment
result = check_experiment(input_data)
return result

data.label: Drift Detection
data.description: Check confidence against running baseline (2-sigma threshold)
data.code:
from services.learner.quality_guard import check_drift
confidence = input_data.get('confidence', 0)
alert = check_drift(confidence)
return {'drift_alert': alert, 'confidence': confidence}

data.label: Cost Gate
data.description: Verify no paid model was used in this experiment

data.label: Alert Router
data.description: Route based on severity: log, warn, or block

data.label: CRITICAL: Block + Alert
data.description: 3-sigma drift or paid model detected. Log to drift.jsonl and send Telegram alert via Jarvis.

data.label: WARNING: Log
data.description: 2-sigma drift or quality check failed. Log to drift.jsonl for review.

data.label: OK: Pass Through
data.description: Experiment passed all checks. No action needed.
